scenario: A deep-ocean research institute qualifies submersible pilots who demonstrate expert mechanical-systems troubleshooting OR certified saturation-dive physiology knowledge. The qualifications are independent in the candidate pool; OR-gate qualification produces a negative within-pilot correlation.

data.description: Population base rates and OR-gate selection mechanism

values.selection_rule: OR gate: selected if (mechanical-systems troubleshooting) OR (saturation-dive physiology knowledge)

question: (a) Derive P(selected) from the OR-gate model. (b) Compute P(mech_systems | ¬dive_physiology, selected) and explain why it equals 1. (c) Compute P(mech_systems | dive_physiology, selected) and show it equals P(mech_systems). (d) Quantify the induced conditional correlation direction and explain why it is a selection artefact rather than a genuine population relationship between mechanical-systems troubleshooting and saturation-dive physiology knowledge.

ground_truth.explanation: Under OR-gate selection a candidate who lacks saturation-dive physiology knowledge must possess mechanical-systems troubleshooting to be admitted — hence P(mech_systems|¬dive_physiology,sel)=1.0. A candidate who already has saturation-dive physiology knowledge is admitted regardless of mechanical-systems troubleshooting, so P(mech_systems|dive_physiology,sel)=P(mech_systems)=0.43. The gap (1.0 vs 0.43) creates a negative within-selected correlation that is purely a collider-selection artefact.

naive_answer: The negative correlation between mechanical-systems troubleshooting and saturation-dive physiology knowledge observed among selected candidates reflects a genuine trade-off between these traits in the domain.
naive_trap: The negative correlation is entirely a Berkson collider artefact produced by the OR-gate admission rule; the two traits are independent in the full population.
reasoning_trace: (1) P(sel)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)=0.43+0.53-0.43×0.53=0.7321. (2) Among candidates without saturation-dive physiology knowledge: only those with mechanical-systems troubleshooting are selected → P(mech_systems|¬dive_physiology,sel)=1.0. (3) Among candidates with saturation-dive physiology knowledge: selected regardless of mechanical-systems troubleshooting → P(mech_systems|dive_physiology,sel)=P(mech_systems)=0.43. (4) Within-selected: knowing ¬dive_physiology raises P(mech_systems) from 0.43 to 1.0 → negative conditional correlation despite population independence.
python_verification:
pA,pB = 0.43,0.53
pSel = pA+pB-pA*pB
assert abs(pSel-0.7321)<0.005, f'pSel={pSel}'
pA_notB_sel = pA*(1-pB)/(pA*(1-pB))   # =1.0 by definition
assert abs(pA_notB_sel-1.0)<1e-9
pA_B_sel = pA*pB/pB                    # =pA by definition
assert abs(pA_B_sel-0.43)<1e-9
assert pA_notB_sel > pA_B_sel, 'negative collider correlation confirmed'
